level_id_bank.verdict: No long-position tool, no trendline and no target is drawn on any frame read. The single drawn object is the 7.47-7.55 green band. Treat the name as UNMARKED: there is no operator-stated entry, stop or target to defer to, so nothing here supersedes an auto-derived read.
level_id_bank.method: Fib (universal level set) -- FOUR stacked ladders solved from printed rung pairs and cross-checked against the printed anchors. Three of the four anchors are drawn on the chart (9.32 / 8.79 and 12.95 / 4.73 / 4.92); ladder 1's anchor low is solved, not drawn.
